watches.name: PLARIDEL 38MM QUARTZ GOLD DRESS WATCH (BLACK STRAP)
watches.description: The Plaridel Quartz watch offers the same timeless aesthetic as its automatic counterpart but with the added affordability of a quartz movement. With its 38mm case size and ion-plated finish, this timepiece exudes a sophisticated charm that suits any occasion. Powered by a reliable Miyota 2015 quartz movement, the Plaridel Quartz ensures precise timekeeping and hassle-free maintenance. The movement operates with exceptional accuracy, providing you with reliable performance day in and day out. The watch features a domed Hesalite crystal, adding a touch of vintage elegance while offering protection to the dial. Its double-sided black leather calfskin strap provides a comfortable and stylish fit, making it suitable for both casual and formal wear. With a water resistance rating of 3 ATM/30m, the Plaridel Quartz can withstand splashes and brief immersion in water, adding an extra layer of durability to its design. Embrace the classic and affordable luxury of the Plaridel Quartz. With its exceptional design and reliable quartz movement, this timepiece is a perfect choice for those who appreciate timeless style without compromising on quality.
